policy.json.threshold: Each code/prose external SSE decode and fresh native prefill median ratio must be strictly >0.90. No compensating aggregate.

policy.json.protection: No DeepSeek changes,no engine upgrade,no source patches,no quality-changing expert skip. Failed candidate never promoted; retain S24 until comparison and normal-launcher proof pass.
